body: Debug, evaluate, and monitor your LLM applications, RAG systems, and agentic workflows with comprehensive tracing, automated evaluations, and production-ready dashboards.
plain_description: Opik gives your team full visibility into every LLM app and AI agent you build — from first prototype to production at scale. Debug issues, run automated evaluations, and monitor performance with production-ready dashboards. Built by Comet, Apache-2.0 licensed, and free to self-host.
technical_description: Opik is an open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform for tracing, evaluating, and monitoring LLM applications and AI agents. The full-stack platform comprises a Java backend, a TypeScript React frontend, Python and TypeScript SDKs, and a REST API. It supports deep tracing of multi-step agent calls with full trace trees, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation metrics including hallucination detection, moderation, and RAG assessment, dataset and experiment management, prompt versioning with a playground, production dashboards with online evaluation rules, and CI/CD integration via PyTest. Deploy via Docker Compose for local development or Helm on Kubernetes for production. Alternatively, use the Comet.com cloud service.
title: Opik
